countingRule: Seven successful concept releases. R08 is a review candidate and is not counted as published.

history.title: METSI Care growth concept and PDF
history.summary: Initial practice-specific predecessor. Historical name only; the current proposal is independent and unaffiliated.

history.title: METSI Care scenario tool and green design
history.summary: Introduced editable comparisons, saving and review-file exchange in the site palette.

history.title: Independent DPC concept, deck and launch model
history.summary: Moved to /dpc/, removed affiliation, added monthly enrollment and cash timing, and preserved earlier files.

history.title: One open worksheet with custom rows
history.summary: Replaced side-by-side editing with one worksheet, blank/zero inputs, addable rows and preserved earlier comparisons.

history.title: Staggered associate schedules and ownership progression
history.summary: Separate 9–9 availability and appointment windows, twelve-encounter ceilings, weekday constraints, roster stages, constrained launch enrollment, updated PDF and revision history.

history.title: Audited staffing, trial pricing and physician incentives
history.summary: Owner Tuesday–Thursday, balanced associate coverage and optional Friday–Monday physician; separate visit mix and routine/urgent demand; provisional coverage budget, recruiting and prepayment sensitivities; pricing, incentives and readable roster.

history.title: Reconciled capacity, compensation and annual prepayment
history.summary: Restored six owner routine visits with a separate urgent reserve; aligned coverage-inclusive expenses, compensation and surplus across the page and PDF; separated physical utilization, bookable capacity, upfront cash and earned revenue; preserved earlier worksheets and the optional junior scenario.
